about_the_game:
You will be the judge of the dead… and every choice will be remembered.

I am Morta, your guide in this place. I will show you the tombs, the broken lives, and the voices that still echo in the dark. But the verdict is yours alone.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Luce Spenta is a gothic and psychological visual novel where power rests in your hands: you will decide the fate of five souls — forgiveness, reproach, oblivion, or execution.

  • 🌑 A gothic, dark atmosphere with detailed art and haunting soundscapes.

  • ⚖️ A moral journey that changes according to your choices.

  • 🔀 More than 25 different endings reflecting the weight of your judgments.

  • 💀 Unexpected and disturbing moments that will test your will.

  • 📖 A mostly narrative experience, perfect to accompany you for several days... or more.

Each grave hides a sin, and every story stirs a different feeling: compassion, anger, rejection, melancholy.
As you move forward, Morta will guide you through this path of broken voices and shattered memories… and what you uncover will also reveal who you truly are.

By looking and analyzing this page, you’re already a judge.
Luce Spenta doesn’t begin when you play it, but when you decide to observe it.

Your eyes read… and Morta’s are already upon you.

Your choices carry weight.
The tombs await your decision.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror themes, mild violence, and occasional disturbing imagery. There are brief suggestive poses of the main character, one scene with a character in underwear, and another where the same character appears deceased in underwear. This game touches sensible themes such as suicide, mental illness, corruption and murder. Some dialogue includes strong or insulting language. There are also a few jump scares and fourth-wall breaking sequences intended to unsettle the player. No explicit sexual activity or graphic violence is depicted.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz Dual-Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Includes all required libraries (SDL2, Python 3 – packaged with Ren’Py)

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or later / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual-Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Includes all required libraries (SDL2, Python 3 – packaged with Ren’Py)

reviews:
“The story drew me in and kept me wanting to know more. Even without voice acting, I felt invested throughout.”
4.5/5 – NeverMoreNiche

“It is a haunting concept that relies on atmosphere, emotion, and reflection more than action, and it succeeds through its strong storytelling and moody presentation.”
8.4/10 – The Drastik Measure

“Luce Spenta does not aim to be lighthearted or escapist. It is an introspective, gothic, emotional, and morally challenging journey. A work constructed with a unique vision, where every soul judged leaves a mark. Even if you are not a fan of the genre, it is worth giving it a chance. It is a project that surprises, unsettles, and lingers.”
4.2/5 – 20xxNoticias
short_description: A gothic psychological visual novel where you must judge the fate of souls. Explore five graves, confront unsettling truths, and make decisions that will shape your path. Every choice is a reflection… and it has consequences.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Latin America, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain, French, Russian, Polish, Greek, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
